invariants.rationale: At least one of the input JsonValue objects is expected to be non-null, otherwise the merge would be meaningless.
parentProps is expected to be an array or null, as the method merges property arrays.
templateProps is expected to be an array or null, due to merging property arrays.
If parentProps is null, templateProps must be an array to return meaningful properties.
If templateProps is null, parentProps must be an array for correct behavior.
